errors.text_span: 与 covid-19 新闻数量， 用蓝色线条表示
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly indicates that the line represents '有关covid-19新闻数量', while it actually shows media reports related to COVID-19, not just any COVID-19-related news.
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart, which is to show the relationship between daily new COVID-19 cases and media reports.
The description fails to mention the specific colors used for the bars and the line, which are important for clarity.
The blue-green bars start at approximately 200,000, not 400,000, and peak at around 160,000 based on the visual data.
The description does not mention the high point of the blue line in terms of numbers accurately compared to the range given in the chart.
